Ghana mobile prefixes by network

A Ghanaian mobile number is ten digits starting with 0, and the two digits after the 0 identify the range the number was issued in. 14 prefixes appear in our checker:

Prefix → network, from the checker that runs on every order

024 MTN MTN MTN bundles

027 MTN / AirtelTigo Shared range — check before you buy MTN bundles

050 Telecel Telecel Telecel bundles
053 Telecel Telecel Telecel bundles
054 MTN MTN MTN bundles
055 MTN MTN MTN bundles
056 MTN MTN MTN bundles
057 MTN MTN MTN bundles
059 MTN MTN MTN bundles

Valid prefixes we accept on an order: 020, 023, 024, 025, 026, 027, 028, 050, 053, 054, 055, 056, 057, 059.

Two honest warnings

1. Some ranges overlap. 026 is claimed by both MTN and AirtelTigo; 027 is claimed by both MTN and AirtelTigo. When a prefix is shared we cannot tell you which network the line is on, so we only warn on a prefix that unambiguously belongs to a different network.

2. Numbers can be ported. Ghana allows mobile number portability, so a number can move network and keep its prefix. The only way to be certain is to ask the person who owns the line, or check on the phone itself.

Why this matters: wrong-number orders are not refundable — a bundle sent to a line on a different network will not deliver, and the industry does not reverse it. That is why the checkout warns you when the prefix you typed does not match the network you picked. Check the line twice before you pay.

Questions people ask before buying

Which network is 024?

024 is an MTN prefix in our checker, along with 025, 026, 027, 054, 055, 056, 057, 059. See MTN bundle prices.

Which network is 020?

020 is Telecel — the network many Ghanaians still call Vodafone. Telecel prefixes in our checker: 020, 023, 050, 053. See Telecel bundle prices.

Which network is 027?

027 falls in a range our checker lists for both AirtelTigo and MTN, so treat it as uncertain and confirm with whoever owns the line before buying. AirtelTigo prices are here.

Can a number change network and keep its prefix?

Yes — Ghana has mobile number portability. A prefix tells you where a number was issued, not necessarily where it lives today.

What happens if I buy data for the wrong network?

The bundle will not deliver to a line on another network, and wrong-number orders are not refundable. Our checkout warns you when the prefix you type belongs unambiguously to a different network.

Which prefixes can I buy data for here?

020, 023, 024, 025, 026, 027, 028, 050, 053, 054, 055, 056, 057, 059 — the full list of valid Ghanaian mobile prefixes our order form accepts.
